title: A Harness Reducing over-Defensive Writing in Agents by Isolating Objections
abstract: arXiv:2610.36717v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When expanding a report, writing with agents may introduce a stronger claim than the article makes and then disclaim it. This is called over-defensive writing. We assume that this is because the agent is writing for responding to an adversarial AI reviewer, instead of a human reader. The defensive context may also influnce the consequent when we simply ban defensive writing in the output through prompts. In order to reduce over-defensive writing, we produce a harness that separates the reviewer, filter, and writer. The writer agent receives only the problems choosen by the filter, which is an independent context. We evaluate this harness on 25 business-project drafts expanded into formal reports, the result shows that the defensive propositions decreased from 59 to 2, which is a 96.61\% reduction, no unsupported factual additions were identified while the source-claim retention rises from 80.35% to 93.12%.

translated_title: 一种通过隔离异议来减少智能体过度防御性写作的框架
translated_abstract: 在扩展报告时，使用智能体写作可能会引入比文章本身更强的主张，然后再对其加以否定，这被称为过度防御性写作。我们假设这是因为智能体是在为回应一个对抗性的AI审稿人而写作，而不是为人类读者写作。当我们仅通过提示词在输出中禁止防御性写作时，防御性上下文也可能影响结果。为了减少过度防御性写作，我们构建了一个将审稿人、过滤器和写作者分离的框架。写作智能体只接收由过滤器挑选出的问题，过滤器拥有独立的上下文。我们在25份被扩展为正式报告的商业项目草稿上评估了该框架，结果显示防御性命题从59个减少到2个，降幅达96.61%，未发现任何无依据的事实添加，同时源主张保留率从80.35%提升至93.12%。
tldr: 该论文提出一种将审稿人、过滤器和写作者分离并通过独立上下文隔离异议的框架，使过度防御性写作减少96.61%，同时将源主张保留率从80.35%提升至93.12%。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a harness that isolates objections by separating the reviewer, filter, and writer into independent contexts, reducing over-defensive writing by 96.61% while improving source-claim retention from 80.35% to 93.12%.
